audience: People who have heard of Tau Net or hold AGRS and want to see what the testnet really does; then anyone curious about a blockchain with rules in logic.
question: How do I get test AGRS and send my first payment?
title: Your first payment on the Tau Net testnet, step by step

scenes.say: Your first payment on the Tau Net testnet needs no sign-up and no download. A wallet is made in your browser, and the chain gives it test coins. Here is how.
scenes.caption: A wallet in your browser

scenes.say: There are four short steps, and the page walks you through them one at a time.
scenes.caption: Four steps

scenes.say: Press New wallet. The key is made in your browser and stays there, so keep the backup it offers you.
scenes.caption: New wallet

scenes.say: A new wallet gets 100,000 test coins once. They have no value. They are for trying things. Then you send: to whom, and how much. That is all a payment is here.
scenes.caption: 100,000 test coins, once

scenes.say: If the chain refuses your payment, you see it here with the reason. Too little balance, or a rule that says no. That refusal is the testnet doing its job.
scenes.caption: Refused, with the reason

scenes.say: Paste your wallet into the explorer and you see your payment in its block. Next: give your wallet a rule of its own.
scenes.caption: Find your payment

description: How to make a wallet in the browser, get test AGRS from the testnet's faucet and send a first payment, and where to see it on the chain. Test coins have no value.

facts.faucet: a new account receives 100,000 test tokens on its first transaction (tauhud.com/facts/, fact 'faucet')
facts.transfer: a transfer is three values: from, to, amount (fact 'transfer')
facts.alpha: its tokens have no real value (fact 'alpha')
